The '''Orphaned Marauder's Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest moon of]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]].

==History==
[[File:OrphanedMaraudersCaveInterior-SWG.jpg|210px|thumb|Female Sanyassan Marauders guarding the cave's interior]]
The Orphaned Marauder's Cave served as a haven for a small group of exiled [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Marauders]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The cave, located on the fringes of the [[Mertuen Forest]], was visited by a number of intrepid [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. The outside of the cave was patrolled by Sanyassans, and a small tent could also be found nearby.<ref name="SWG:OMC" />

[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Lavina]] also used the outside of the cave as a base for her shady activities.<ref name="SWG:SIC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Smuggler|Smuggle Illicit Contraband|Yavin 4}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] visited the village and collected the [[Razor knuckler|Necrosis Nightblade]].<ref name="SWG:RMWMIII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark III}}</ref>
